HOMECONNECT.NAME: Home Connect
HOMECONNECT.DESCRIPTION: Home Connect appliances (Bosch, Siemens, Neff, Gaggenau, ...) via the official Home Connect API

API_URL.NAME: API URL
API_URL.DESCRIPTION: https://api.home-connect.com, or https://simulator.home-connect.com for the appliance simulator of the developer portal

CLIENT_ID.NAME: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.DESCRIPTION: Client ID of your application on developer.home-connect.com (authorization type Device Flow)

REFRESH_TOKEN.NAME: Refresh token
REFRESH_TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Empty = the driver starts a device login and shows the link and code under Login status

POLL.NAME: Full read interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: Changes arrive live through the event stream. Home Connect allows 1000 requests per day, each full read costs 1 + 4 per appliance

SCAN.NAME: Search appliances
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the appliances of the account

LOGIN_STATUS.NAME: Login status
LOGIN_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: OK, or the link and code to confirm the login with your Home Connect account

OPERATION_STATE.NAME: Operation state
OPERATION_STATE.DESCRIPTION: Inactive, Ready, DelayedStart, Run, Pause, ActionRequired, Finished, Error, Aborting

REMOTE_START_ALLOWED.NAME: Remote start allowed
REMOTE_START_ALLOWED.DESCRIPTION: Remote start has to be enabled on the appliance before programs can be started

POWER.NAME: Power
POWER.DESCRIPTION: Write true to switch on, false to switch off (or standby)

ACTIVE_PROGRAM.NAME: Active program
ACTIVE_PROGRAM.DESCRIPTION: Program key, e.g. Dishcare.Dishwasher.Program.Eco50. Write a key to start it, an empty text to stop

SELECTED_PROGRAM.NAME: Selected program
SELECTED_PROGRAM.DESCRIPTION: Write a program key to select it

RUNNING.NAME: Program running
RUNNING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start the selected program with its options, false to stop

PAUSED.NAME: Paused
PAUSED.DESCRIPTION: Write true to pause and false to resume (if the appliance supports it)

LAST_EVENT.NAME: Last event
LAST_EVENT.DESCRIPTION: Key of the last event, e.g. BSH.Common.Event.ProgramFinished

CUSTOM_NUMBER.NAME: Value (number)
CUSTOM_NUMBER.DESCRIPTION: Any numeric status, setting or option by its Home Connect key

CUSTOM_SWITCH.NAME: Value (switch)
CUSTOM_SWITCH.DESCRIPTION: Any boolean status, setting or option, or a command (write true), by its Home Connect key

CUSTOM_TEXT.NAME: Value (text)
CUSTOM_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Any status, setting or option by its Home Connect key, enum values as full key

CUSTOM_KEY.NAME: Home Connect key
CUSTOM_KEY.DESCRIPTION: e.g. Refrigeration.FridgeFreezer.Setting.SetpointTemperatureRefrigerator or Cooking.Oven.Status.CurrentCavityTemperature. .Setting. and .Option. keys can be written
